title: ADMINISTRATIVE EXEMPTION and COMMUNICATION FROM THE BOARD OF AIRPORT COMMISSIONERS relative to the proposed Fourth Amendment to Terminal Facilities Lease…
text:
[Council File 20-0439-S3]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
ADMINISTRATIVE EXEMPTION and COMMUNICATION FROM THE BOARD OF AIRPORT COMMISSIONERS relative to the proposed Fourth Amendment to Terminal Facilities Lease and License Agreement LAA-8965 with Air Canada for space in Terminal 6 at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. CONCUR with the Board of Airport Commissioners' action on September 23, 2026, in finding that the proposed amendment is administratively exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE Board of Airport Commissioners Resolution No. 28483 authorizing the Fourth Amendment to Terminal Facilities Lease and License Agreement LAA-8965 with Air Canada, extending the term through June 30, 2035, for space in Terminal 6 at LAX, updating the lease provisions to incorporate the airport-wide Gate Use Protocol, and establishing rent credits for the use of Air Canada's preferential use gates by common-use airlines.
3. CONCUR with the action taken by the Board of Airport Commissioners on September 23, 2026, by Resolution No. 28483, authorizing the Chief Executive Officer, Los Angeles World Airports, or designee, to execute said amendment, subject to approval by the City Council and approval as to form by the City Attorney.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board of Airport Commissioners reports that approval of the proposed amendment will ensure continued revenue to Los Angeles World Airports estimated at approximately $8.7 million for the current fiscal year under the agreement. There is no anticipated impact to the General Fund. The City Administrative Officer and Chief Legislative Analyst have not completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Trade, Travel and Tourism Committee waived consideration of the above matter.)
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 13, 2026
